title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A startup scan you had not asked for
summary: The Remove unused quick fixes prime a full project scan at startup so the first lightbulb does not keep VS Code waiting. That scan ran whether or not you had asked for those actions.

highlights.title: The warm up reads the setting
highlights.description: With kotlinJump.deadWeightQuickFixes switched off, nothing is read at startup and nothing is held in memory.

highlights.title: 40.8 MB and 92 ms
highlights.description: What the scan costs on a real project of 6278 files, measured with interleaved passes. Raising the ceiling last release took it from 26.5 MB and 60 ms.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The quick fix provider scanned the whole project at activation without ever looking at its own setting.
Switching the setting back on still works: the first lightbulb then pays the scan once, which is what the warm up spares.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Nothing changes for anyone who leaves the quick fixes on.
